records.title: Fragments of a Listening Soul
records.summary: Poetry, voice, image, and sound listen for what memory, grief, identity, and love leave behind.
records.alt: Cover of Fragments of a Listening Soul by Aham Efula Ezenwata Nwede

records.title: The Meadow Chronicles
records.tagline: Old wisdom has a mischievous way of finding us.
records.summary: In the Meadow, family memory becomes playful adventure, and every muddy mistake carries a lesson home.
records.alt: Cover of Nwaybulakur and the Sneaky Rock, representing The Meadow Chronicles

records.title: You Don’t Know
records.tagline: Some truths can only be heard.
records.summary: A music-and-image world where longing, revelation, and the unspoken meet between one note and the next.
records.alt: You Don’t Know cover with musicians reaching toward one another in a celestial scene

records.title: Flawed
records.tagline: The fracture may be part of the blueprint.
records.summary: A meditation on becoming—where imperfection is not the failure of design, but evidence of being alive.
records.alt: Flawed project cover, The Blueprint of Being

records.title: Adventures of Terrapin
records.tagline: Slow feet. Quick wit. Trouble close behind.
records.summary: Terrapin wanders into a world of character, consequence, and adventures that rarely go according to plan.
records.alt: Terrapin walking through a luminous forest

records.title: The Next Riff
records.tagline: The next sound is already waiting inside.
records.summary: Outside a glowing venue, the line grows longer. Beyond the doors, music gathers toward its next beginning.
records.alt: A nighttime music venue with people lined up beneath The Next Riff sign, its final F unlit

records.title: 8 Billion Murderers
records.tagline: Humanity is on trial. The universe is listening.
records.summary: A restrained cosmic tragicomedy in which law, time, and eight billion human contradictions are summoned before an impossible court.
records.alt: Final poster artwork for 8 Billion Murderers

records.title: Nwaybulakur and the Sneaky Rock
records.subtitle: A Muddy Little Lesson
records.tagline: One mossy rock. More than one way to learn.
records.summary: A suspiciously well-placed rock sends Nwaybulakur into a muddy encounter where mischief, consequence, and old wisdom meet.
records.alt: Cover of Nwaybulakur and the Sneaky Rock: A Muddy Little Lesson

records.title: Don't Cry Over Spilled Milk
records.tagline: A little spill can make a very big commotion.
records.summary: A spilled pail sets the Meadow in motion, and the flock discovers that making things right matters more than making a fuss.
records.alt: Cover of Don't Cry Over Spilled Milk

records.title: Nwaybulakur and the Little Drops of Water
records.subtitle: A Tale of Patience
records.tagline: Patience grows one little drop at a time.
records.summary: At Sleeping Hollow, Nwaybulakur learns that small, steady efforts can accomplish what impatience cannot hurry.
records.alt: Cover of Nwaybulakur and the Little Drops of Water: A Tale of Patience

records.title: Common Sense Is Not Common
records.subtitle: The Great Umbrella Upheaval
records.tagline: It takes more than an umbrella to understand the weather.
records.summary: When rain reaches the Meadow, a cheerful umbrella upheaval proves that what seems obvious is not always common—and good sense still asks us to look closely.
records.alt: Cover of Common Sense Is Not Common: The Great Umbrella Upheaval

records.title: CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!
records.subtitle: A Woolly Tale About Why Empty Cans Make the Most Noise
records.tagline: The emptiest can is often the loudest.
records.summary: A noisy discovery rattles across the Meadow, giving the flock a memorable lesson about commotion, attention, and what may—or may not—be inside.

records.title: CLANG! CLANG! CLANG! 2
records.subtitle: A Woolly Sequel About Empty Cans Making the Most Noise
records.tagline: The noise returns—and the Meadow listens again.
records.summary: The clang comes back with a new troublemaker and another round of woolly commotion, extending the lesson about noise, notice, and empty cans.

records.title: Baffle-Fluff and the Blackberry Barn
records.tagline: A berry-sized temptation can stain a whole afternoon.
records.summary: At the Blackberry Barn, a tempting harvest and one lively flock turn a simple visit into a lesson marked in purple.
records.alt: Cover of Baffle-Fluff and the Blackberry Barn

records.title: Nwaybulakur and the Slow-and-Steady Race
records.tagline: The surest way forward is to keep going.
records.summary: A bright Meadow race tests speed against steadiness, while Nwaybulakur and Baffle-Fluff discover what it means to finish with patience and purpose.
records.alt: Cover of Nwaybulakur and the Slow-and-Steady Race
